external_runner_limitation: Three NVIDIA Nemotron-Mini-4B requests were committed to the verified runner but no result artifact was present at closure. They are excluded from evidence and remain a follow-up, not a hidden success/failure.
epistemic_validation: Synthetic E2B measurements are labeled mechanism tests, not live FRANK effect sizes.
Peer-reviewed papers, preprints, primary docs, GitHub implementation evidence and Reddit practitioner evidence retain distinct evidence classes.
Generic hosted 4B is never called Qwen3-4B evidence.
Cross-branch agreement is not counted as independent replication.
reason: No exact target-Qwen/full-adaptation continuity result, no live FRANK CACC intervention, no independent end-to-end replication, no Android sustained benchmark, no prospective E-CERT2 continuity certificate.
